shared_elements: carved/incised outline imagery on stone surface
repeated small linear marks suggesting figures or signs
justification: The only real overlap is that both surfaces carry incised outline imagery including human figures, and both include repeated small marks (crew strokes in A, glyph-like blocks in B). A shows a dispersed field of profile boats with rows of stick-figure crew and small scattered animals/figures, while B shows a single large frontal-standing elaborately costumed personage filling the panel with attached headdress and glyph panel, so subject, relationships and composition are entirely different.
